entities.summary: Ludwig Gundacker von Althan (b. 1665-05-15, Zwentendorf an der Donau) was a religious figure or clergy of the Early Modern period, marked by exploration, reformation, and the rise of nation-states, active in Zwentendorf an der Donau. Known in the fields of architects & engineers.
